[LSTO.4.3.3] There is **no cache-read (`cached`) callback.** The
engine serves `cached()` from its own in-engine map ([LSTO.4.7.1]);
no integration code runs to serve a read. A read that meets an expired
entry removes it, and that removal fires the integrator's removal callback
([NSTG.2.4.2]). A read cannot fail for want of a registered callback
— a miss reads as `null` ([LSTO.4.3.1a]).
